headline: Outlier AI Review: Jobs, Pay & Application Process (2026)
description: Outlier AI review covering roles, pay ranges, the general reasoning screening, and community-reported experiences from Scale AI's contributor platform.

acceptedAnswer.text: Outlier is a platform for building AI with expert human input, operated by Scale AI, where freelancers evaluate and improve AI model outputs across many domains.

mainEntity.name: Is Outlier AI operated by Scale AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Outlier AI is a contributor platform operated by Scale AI, founded in 2016 by Alexandr Wang and Lucy Guo.

mainEntity.name: What score do I need to pass the Outlier AI screening?

acceptedAnswer.text: 80% or higher on the General Reasoning Screening.

mainEntity.name: What is Oracle status on Outlier AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outlier's top-tier quality designation, giving access to higher-paying projects and somewhat more queue stability, though it doesn't prevent account removal when a project ends.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a degree to work for Outlier AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most specialist roles (writing, art, coding, fact-checking, medical) require a relevant bachelor's degree or higher; requirements vary by role.

mainEntity.name: What is the minimum time commitment for Outlier AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: None - there are no minimum hour requirements.

mainEntity.name: What coding languages does Outlier AI require?

acceptedAnswer.text: Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, Swift, or Verilog, depending on the project.
